import sys

def power_mod(base, exp, mod):
    res = 1
    while exp > 0:
        if exp & 1:
            res = (res * base) % mod
        base = (base * base) % mod
        exp >>= 1
    return res

MAX_SIZE = 300005
dp_state = [[0] * MAX_SIZE for _ in range(27)]
fact = [0] * MAX_SIZE
inv_fact = [0] * MAX_SIZE

def get_permutation(n, m, mod):
    return (fact[n] * inv_fact[n - m]) % mod

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n, K, MOD = map(int, input_data)
    if n % 2 != 0:
        print(power_mod(K, n, MOD))
        return
    fact[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD
    inv_fact[n] = power_mod(fact[n], MOD - 2, MOD)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        inv_fact[i] = (inv_fact[i + 1] * (i + 1)) % MOD
    dp_state[0][0] = 1
    for k in range(K):
        for i in range(1, n + 1):
            if (i & n) != i:
                continue
            block_mask = 1 << (31 - (i.bit_length() - 1))
            res = 0
            j = i
            cnt = 0
            while True:
                j_minus = (j - 1) & i
                j_plus = j_minus + block_mask
                if j_plus > i:
                    break
                res += dp_state[k][i ^ j_plus] * inv_fact[j_plus]
                cnt += 1
                if cnt == 17:
                    res %= MOD
                    cnt = 0
                if j_minus == 0:
                    break
                j = j_minus
            res %= MOD
            dp_state[k + 1][i] = res
    total_result = 0
    for i in range(K + 1):
        total_result = (total_result + fact[n] * dp_state[i][n] * get_permutation(K, i, MOD)) % MOD
    print((power_mod(K, n, MOD) + MOD - total_result) % MOD)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
